scope: Chosen fictional open-range scenario: arithmetic only, no measured or predicted deployment performance.

energy_accounting.convention: Q is deposited nuclear energy / delivered pulse energy. The fluence uses immediate capture heat; O15 decay, neutrinos and later processing are separate. Recover the delivered input heat once.
energy_accounting.shield_qualification: The last value is a toy energy/enthalpy quotient, not an ablation depth or a validated shield. Spectrum, ion stopping, impulse, nonuniformity and surface transients remain unknown.

flight_and_source_requirements.qualification: Characteristic flight and ballistic sensitivities only; all-kinetic outward speed is illustrative. Arrival distributions and useful diagnostic/shield timing require a computed outgoing spectrum.

open_space_thermal_environment.assumed_radiation_geometry: Direct sunlight only. Nearby equipment and prior shots can dominate local radiation and residual gas.

accelerator_scenario.qualification: An example necessary requirement; no demonstrated material or accelerator. Acceleration may occur outside the range launch radius. Film mass, core strength, hydrogen retention and composition must be counted.

charge_neutralization_requirement.qualification: Unscreened uniform-sphere electrostatic example, not the real beam geometry. Charged grains cannot coast inward unchanged; a discharge or charge-neutralization system must act before convergence. Electron mass is small, but its transport, currents, grain heating and final trajectory corrections are unmodeled.

gravity.qualification: Tidal and self-gravity perturbations are small over flight. Rotation of orbit-following nodes requires predictable aiming corrections; no gravity-supported full collector shell is assumed.

remaining_requirements: Measured partially ionized cold-material EOS and shock Hugoniot.
Discrete pellet collision, vaporization, ionization and multidimensional liner formation.
Full reaction network and delayed O15 decay heat/neutrino accounting.
Source hardware, pellet coating/strength/retention, field emission and finite accelerator geometry.
Open-range diagnostic capture, spectrum-dependent shielding and safe shot cadence.
Other catalytic stages, separation and recovery before any closed hydrogen-to-helium cycle claim.
